Case studies

The work behind the result.

Every engagement starts with a business problem, not technology for its own sake. We assess what is failing, identify the underlying cause, implement the right solution and stay involved to help keep the system working.

The examples below follow a simple structure: the challenge, what we changed and the practical result.

Case 01 · Security

SearchPath Arabia

Recruitment platform · Security incident response and recovery

The challenge

SearchPath Arabia experienced an active security breach. An attacker was creating unauthorised administrator accounts and hiding legitimate user accounts, putting platform integrity and operations at risk.

What we did

We investigated the incident, cleaned affected files and data, restored the platform and applied security hardening measures intended to prevent the same attack path from being used again.

The result

The platform was restored within 48 hours, with no reported data loss. It returned to supporting more than 100 active job listings, including automated third-party imports.

48 hoursFull remediation
No reportedData loss
100+Active job listings

“Dakyworld remediated our security breach in 48 hours with zero data loss.”

Operations Lead, SearchPath Arabia
Case 02 · Revenue

Laluxrys

Consumer commerce · Mobile website performance and lead capture

The challenge

Laluxrys had a broken responsive product grid on its shop pages. Customers using mobile devices could not reliably browse products, creating friction at a critical point in the buying journey.

What we did

We rebuilt the product-grid experience for responsive performance, tested it across key screen sizes and introduced a WhatsApp consultation flow for customers who needed help before purchasing.

The result

The mobile shopping experience became consistent again, while the new consultation flow began capturing more than 30 qualified customer enquiries each month.

30+Qualified monthly enquiries
MobileShopping experience restored

“Our mobile shop finally looks and works the way it should.”

Founder, Laluxrys
Case 03 · Efficiency

Dakyworld Marketing Hub

Internal product case study · Automation, AI and CRM integration

The challenge

Managing a content calendar manually consumed more than 30 hours each month. The team also lacked one connected workspace for content planning, publishing, lead generation and CRM activity.

What we did

We built a multi-platform publishing dashboard with AI-assisted content creation, automated planning and publishing, lead-generation tools and CRM synchronisation.

The result

The system reduced manual effort by 70%. A week of content can now be planned in under one hour, and more than 30 hours of recurring monthly work have been returned to the team.

70%Manual effort removed
Under 1 hourTo plan a week of content
30+ hoursReturned every month

“What used to take our team a full week now takes under an hour.”

Ongoing ownership

A project ends. Responsibility continues.

Every case on this page began as a problem somebody had been living with. A security risk, a poor mobile experience or hours of repetitive manual work can continue unnoticed when no one has responsibility for checking the systems behind the business.

That is why our work does not end at delivery. We remain involved to maintain, monitor and improve the technology your business depends on.

The pattern

Different symptoms. One missing role.

Different symptoms. One missing role.

These cases looked different on the surface, but they shared one issue: nobody had clear responsibility for noticing, maintaining and improving the system.

Dakyworld fills that gap. We take ongoing responsibility for the digital systems your business runs on, rather than completing a project and disappearing.
